urls.$terms_comment: Apple's standard EULA — the same URL LuminaLegalLinks opens in the app. A custom terms page would have to be maintained in two places and match the binary exactly; the standard one can't drift.

contact.$comment: Used for the App Store Connect support field, the App Review contact, and the published pages. lumina.app was never registered, so every address at it bounced — an unmonitored support contact is a rejection. aso_lint.py fails on any address at that domain and checks this one is actually on the support page.

en-US.name: Lumina: Birth Chart Astrology
en-US.subtitle: Daily transits, moon, synastry
en-US.promotional_text: Real planetary math, not generated horoscopes. Every line traces back to a placement in your own chart — or we don't write it.
en-US.description:
Finally, an astrology app that doesn't fake it.

Most apps in this category approximate your planetary positions, generate horoscopes that would fit anyone, and bury the cancel button. Lumina does none of that.

YOUR CHART, COMPUTED — NOT GUESSED

Lumina draws your birth chart from a real ephemeris: the same planetary math astronomers use. Exact degrees, real house cusps, true aspect angles. Choose Placidus, Whole-sign or Sidereal houses — your planets stay put, only the frame changes. No birth time? You still get your real signs and planets, and we tell you plainly which parts need a time instead of inventing them.

EVERY WORD TIED TO A PLACEMENT

Today's reading is built from the transits actually happening to your chart right now — the planet, the aspect, the natal point it touches, the exact orb. Tap "Why these?" and you see the raw data behind every sentence. If a line can't be traced back to your chart, it doesn't get written.

WHAT'S INSIDE

• Today — your reading from real transits, the live moon phase and its ritual, what's retrograde, and what's coming next
• Birth chart — an interactive wheel, every placement explained in plain language, plus your Big Three and the standouts that make your chart yours
• Ask your chart — grounded answers about your own placements, never invented
• Moon — a 3D moon lit by the true Sun-Moon-Earth angle for tonight, not a stock illustration
• People — add friends and partners, see the real synastry aspects between your charts and the composite chart you make together
• Human Design — your bodygraph from the same birth data: defined centres, channels, type and authority
• Reflect — a private journal that stays on your device, with prompts drawn from the sky that day
• Home-screen widget — your sky, kept current

HONEST BY DESIGN

Your reflections and your friends' names never leave your iPhone. Your birth details go to our chart service to compute your chart and nothing is stored there. Export everything you've written whenever you want. Delete your account from inside the app — no email, no support ticket.

No streaks. No push notifications engineered to pull you back. No countdown timers on the paywall. Cancel is one tap from Settings, and we'll never hide it.

LUMINA PLUS

The daily reading and your full birth chart are free, permanently — they're the reason to open the app. Plus adds Human Design, compatibility for everyone you add, the months-ahead transit forecast, and the widget.

A note on what we don't do: Lumina doesn't read palms today. We're building it on-device, and we'd rather say that than fake it with a stock overlay.

For entertainment purposes. Astrology is a lens for reflection, not a substitute for professional advice.
en-US.whats_new:
Lumina 1.0.

Your chart, computed from a real ephemeris — exact degrees, real houses, true aspects. Daily readings built from the transits actually hitting your chart, with the raw data one tap away. A 3D moon lit by tonight's real phase angle. Synastry and composite charts for the people you add. Your Human Design bodygraph. A private journal that never leaves your iPhone.

We'd rather ship what's real than claim what isn't. Palm reading is being built on-device and will arrive when it works fairly for everyone — not before.

es-MX.$comment: English long-tail. The US storefront indexes es-MX metadata alongside en-US, and this field is never shown to a user — see docs/aso/KEYWORD-RESEARCH.md §5.

en-GB.$comment: Third indexed keyword field. Serves the UK storefront for certain, and is reported to feed US indexing too — verify before counting on the US half.

in_app_purchases.description: One year of everything in Lumina Plus.

review.notes:
Lumina computes real charts from a Swiss-Ephemeris backend, so the app needs network access to show its main content.

WHAT TO ENTER
Onboarding asks for a birth date, time and place. Any values work; for a chart with every feature populated, use 14 March 1990, 09:25, Stockholm, Sweden.

WHERE THE SUBSCRIPTION IS
Settings > Lumina Plus opens the paywall, and every gated surface (Chart > Human Design, People > any person > Compatibility, Today > Ahead > What's coming) offers it too. Restore Purchases is on the paywall and in Settings > Account.

ACCOUNT DELETION
Settings > Account > Delete account removes the account and all server-side data in-app, per Guideline 5.1.1(v). No email or support request is involved.

WHAT THIS BUILD DOES NOT DO
The app does not read palms. Earlier marketing mentioned it; nothing in this binary claims it as a shipping feature, the Palm tab is not present, and the in-app FAQ states plainly that it isn't built yet.

ENTERTAINMENT DISCLAIMER
Astrological content is presented for entertainment and self-reflection, disclosed on the Today tab, in Settings > About, and in the description.

accuracy_rules.$comment: Enforced by scripts/aso_lint.py. Terms that must not appear in any user-visible metadata field while the feature is unreachable in the binary (Guideline 2.3.1).
accuracy_rules.forbidden_terms_reason: No palm capture, no tarot deck, no numerology engine ships in 1.0. Keywords are indexed metadata and fall under the same accuracy rule as the app name.
